WITH bike_days AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS bikes_considered,
    SUM(julianday('2024-12-31') - julianday(acquired_on) + 1) AS total_bike_days
  FROM bikes
),
tech_jobs AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    COUNT(*) AS maintenance_jobs
  FROM maintenance
  GROUP BY technician_id
)
SELECT
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  COALESCE(bd.bikes_considered, 0) AS bikes_considered,
  COALESCE(tj.maintenance_jobs, 0) * 1.0 / bd.total_bike_days AS maintenance_jobs_per_bike_day
FROM technicians t
CROSS JOIN bike_days bd
LEFT JOIN tech_jobs tj
  ON tj.technician_id = t.technician_id
ORDER BY maintenance_jobs_per_bike_day DESC, t.technician_id ASC
